title: Durchsuchungen und Festnahme wegen Raubtat am S-Bahnhof Karlshorst

extraction.summaryEn: Five suspects, aged 14 to 21, were charged over a group assault and robbery of a 31-year-old man at Karlshorst station on 9 May 2026; police raided seven addresses in several states. The victim was hospitalised, and one suspect was arrested for threatening a pursuer with a blank-firing pistol.
